children: Tidewater entered into a Guarantee Agreement with BNDES to back the full and timely payment of its Brazilian subsidiary’s obligations under the BNDES Construction Loans. The guarantee is unsecured and ranks pari passu with Tidewater’s other unsecured, unsubordinated obligations. The company is working with BNDES to release prior guarantors Wilson Sons and Remolcadores from the legacy loan facilities, consolidating support under Tidewater.
: Unsecured guarantee of BNDES Construction Loans
: Until BNDES Construction Loans are repaid
: Support Brazilian subsidiary loans and facilitate release of prior guarantors

title: Tidewater Issues Unsecured Guarantee of BNDES Construction Loans for Brazilian Subsidiary
